mentions.name: Octelium
mentions.description: Octelium is a FOSS unified zero trust secure access platform that can operate as a modern zero-config remote access VPN, a ZTNA/BeyondCorp platform, an API/AI/LLM gateway, infrastructure for MCP gateways and agentic AI architectures/meshes, a PaaS-like platform, an ngrok alternative, or homelab infrastructure. It provides a Kubernetes-like zero trust architecture for secure access and deployment across human-to-workload, workload-to-workload, and hybrid environments.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Octelium https://github.com/octelium/octelium  a FOSS unified zero trust secure access platform that is flexible enough to operate as a modern zero-config remote access VPN, a Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)/BeyondCorp platform, an API/AI/LLM gateway, an infrastructure for MCP gateways and agentic AI architectures/meshes, a PaaS-like platform, ngrok alternative, and even as a homelab infrastructure.
